detail.longDescription: Open tabs as working memory externalization is very ADHD-coded. The browser keeps your context alive because losing it is genuinely costly. The problem: one crash, one restart, context gone. Wrote about Firefox settings + extensions that work with this pattern: https:// dev.to/weatherclockdash/firefo x-settings-and-extensions-that-help-with-adhd-and-focus-32mj # ADHD # Neurodiversity # Productivity # Firefox
